buddy.source: This repository, including its NR FPGA lowering changes; not the triton-riscv buddy-hash.txt checkout.

llvm.source: This repository llvm submodule, built with MLIR and RISC-V/BOSCAME targets.

pytorch.note: Optional for these offline ASTSource frontends; upstream execution driver expects torch. Use existing boscame package or the PyTorch CPU index.

json.source: Triton cmake/json-version.txt pinned upstream download, or JSON_SYSPATH override

source_constraints: The qwen3 reference repository supplies model architecture only; no v0.1 operator or instruction implementation is imported.
The Triton repository is the genuine Python JIT/TTIR frontend; generated linalg is lowered by this repository Buddy NR implementation.
NR instruction encodings and FPGA boot/link conventions come from the ModelZoo hardware reference, with maintained code under FPGA-BOSCAME/common and tools.
The full Qwen model weights are not needed for per-operator deterministic validation.
The compatibility patch only adapts SymbolName/SymbolVisibility and the LLVM InlineAsmOp convergent parameter to this LLVM commit.
